source.author: ov
source.text: Sanguine et igne micant oculi, riget horrida cervix, et sactae similes rigidis hastilibus horrent stantque velut vallum, velut alta hastilia saetae fervida cum rauco latos stridore per armos spuma fluit, dentes aequantur dentibus Indis, fulmen ab ore venit, frondes afflatibus ardent.
source.text_original: Sanguine et igne micant oculi, riget horrida cervix, / [et sactae similes rigidis hastilibus horrent / stantque velut vallum, velut alta hastilia saetae] / fervida cum rauco latos stridore per armos / spuma fluit, dentes aequantur dentibus Indis, / fulmen ab ore venit, frondes afflatibus ardent.
source.text_english: Their eyes gleam with blood and fire; their bristling necks stand stiff, and their bristles, like rigid spearshafts, stand up in frightful array and rise like a palisade, like tall spearshafts. Hot foam flows over their broad shoulders with a hoarse hiss; their teeth match the teeth of Indian beasts, lightning comes from their mouths, and their breath sets the leaves ablaze.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Ecce per obliqui rapidum compendia montis ductor avens laetusque dolis agnoscit Acastum horrentem iaculis et parmae luce coruscum.
reuse.text_original: Ecce per obliqui rapidum compendia montis / ductor avens laetusque dolis agnoscit Acastum / horrentem iaculis et parmae luce coruscum.
reuse.text_english: Look, by the steep shortcuts of the slanting mountain, the leader, eager and glad at the stratagem, recognizes Acastus, bristling with spears and flashing with the sheen of his round shield.
